I need to look at your current setup to build this right. I don't have your current weight logged yet, so I can't see where you're starting from. That matters — the gap between here and 100 lbs sets what we're doing.

Log your weight on the Body Metrics screen, and then we can talk about what a plan looks like. Once I know your numbers, I'll ask you a few things about your training goal — are we building muscle, cutting, or something else — and what you're working with for equipment and time. That's what the app needs to build you a solid plan, not just a number.
